digest.component_or_area: Jira DC reconciler — capability detection, Epic-field contract validation, inbound probe port
propositions: Capability map validation must occur post-run and refuse to vouch for Epic-field reports it cannot verify, exiting non-zero with verdict in run_metadata.json

Capability call sites must be runtime-guarded with isinstance-primary and hasattr-fallback logic, reporting capability-absent vs capability-raised distinctly on bridge_alerts rather than failing silently

The inbound absence-probe port and its related units (SupportsAbsenceProbe, classify_probe_response, probe_remote implementations) must be deleted per operator ruling, with the decision recorded outside the repo
Unit tests must prove system-only field inventory readiness validation by pinning failure cases, not relying on configuration alone
Live DC harness regression must not occur from these three changes; pre-existing failures from commit c87afedba8 are tracked separately on ticket 9590
No test cells may be deleted, skipped, or xfail-marked to achieve passing status; only one pre-existing xfail owned by ticket 2b16 exists in the live harness
